subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: Should OpenClaw repair corrupted Dashboard session mappings automatically, report them as diagnostic-only, or wait for a redacted fixture before changing user history state?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the durable rule for choosing the correct preserved transcript or trajectory is a product and data-safety choice rather than a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Fixture-backed doctor repair
options.body: Require a redacted bad store plus preserved transcript fixture, then add an explicit doctor repair that only relinks when metadata evidence is unambiguous.

options.title: Diagnostic-only first
options.body: Add a safe doctor warning that identifies suspicious mappings and asks the user to confirm before any automated rewrite exists.

options.title: Defer until more reports
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until more affected stores establish the corruption pattern and safe matching rules.

recommendation.title: Fixture-backed doctor repair
recommendation.body: Require a redacted bad store plus preserved transcript fixture, then add an explicit doctor repair that only relinks when metadata evidence is unambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent transcript-reader/session-identity work makes this the closest current owner boundary for deciding how reads and future repairs should identify history.
